DPP ousts 18 members over independent local election bids
summary: Taipei, Sept. 24 (CNA) The ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) said Thursday it had expelled 18 party members, including former Changhua City Mayor Chiu Chien-fu (邱建富) and Taipei City Councilor Chen E-jun (陳怡君), for running in the Nov. 28 local elections without party backing.

title: MOFA hails support from 8 nations on Taiwan Strait status quo
summary: Taipei, Sept. 24 (CNA) Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) on Thursday thanked eight European and Indo-Pacific countries for opposing unilateral changes to the status quo across the Taiwan Strait in a joint statement issued earlier this week.

title: DPP township council candidate dies after collapsing on stage
summary: Taipei, Sept. 23 (CNA) Chiu Feng-ing (邱鳳英), a Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) candidate for township councilor in Hualien County's Xincheng Township, died Wednesday morning after collapsing onstage at a Moon Festival event Tuesday night.
